## Working-backwards press release: ggen projection drift repairs itself without a model

**v26.9.24.** A projection that ggen generated drifts when a person edits the generated file
or the ontology changes without a sync.
Starting with v26.9.24, ggen projection-drift repair is a KNOWN class.
The same sJira, SA2A and XaaS pipeline that repairs format drift in v26.9.23 now repairs
projection drift, and no LLM participates on the path.

### What is observably true when GC-26.9.24 is complete

GC24-0, accepted prose: the operator accepted this prose, and the GC-26.9.24 work orders are
recomputed from it by mix semantic_jira.compile_prose with no hand-authored backlog.

GC24-1, detection: the ggen-sync-check verifier runs ggen sync --check in a clean worktree
of the episode subject and exits non-zero whenever a generated file differs from what ggen
sync renders.

GC24-2, deterministic repair: the capability recipe:ggen-sync resolves to the recipe-worker
provider, which runs ggen sync on the drifted subject and commits only files that ggen sync renders.

GC24-3, independent consequence: an independent run of ggen sync --check on a fresh worktree at
the produced head exits 0, and the same check exits non-zero when the recipe commit is reverted.

Episode subjects are xaas commits on a dedicated branch v24/episode-<name> that hand-edit one
generated projection.

### Invariants, exclusions and falsifiers

No LLM, network model API or zcode binary participates on the projection-drift repair path.
Only files that ggen sync renders change in the repair commit.
The repair never publishes to a registry: no hex, crates, npm, GHCR or Homebrew publish.
The repair uses no network access beyond ggen pack fetch.
Episode drift commits are never made on friday/gc-fri-0800 or main.
The class is falsified when a hand-edited generated file survives the repair while the court
exits 0.
The class is falsified when ggen sync --check still exits 0 after the recipe commit is reverted.

### Not in scope

Naming a capability grants no authority.
Until recipe:ggen-sync is registered in the XaaS recipe registry, resolving it yields a typed
UNSUPPORTED(provider_capability) successor item, not an error.
